_why: On 2026-04-30 a three-advisor debate (debates/002-orchestrator-cycle-stop) concluded: stop building autonomous multi-pane orchestrators on top of generic LLM CLIs. Its own words: 'without P5, in 6 weeks we will rationalize iteration 4 the same way we rationalized 1->2 and 2->3.' Iteration #3 landed at 8 weeks, then #4 (ClawTrol control plane, 2026-07-27), then #5 (orchestrator-waker, 2026-08-05). The decision was overridden three times because it was PROSE and nothing could fail when it was violated. This file is the enforcement artifact: test/no-new-coordinator.test.cjs fails when a module with the always-on-coordinator shape appears in src/ that is not listed here. Adding an entry is cheap and takes ten seconds - the point is that it cannot happen SILENTLY, and that the next person sees this list and the history before adding number seven.
_what_counts: A module whose filename suggests a coordinator (waker/watchdog/sentinel/orchestrator/heartbeat/monitor/scheduler), or one that combines setInterval with sending text to panes. Those two shapes are what every failed iteration had in common: a background loop that decides on its own to drive other agents.
_how_to_add: Add an entry with the module, a one-line what, and the operator ruling that authorised it (date + what was agreed). If there is no operator ruling, that is the signal you are building iteration #7 - stop and say so out loud instead of adding a line here.
